label: Rigid bodies
text: EN.O.A1.1 Rigid bodies. Statics: ΣF = 0 and ΣM = 0 when inertia is negligible. Dynamics: ΣF = m a and ΣM = dH/dt about the centre of mass or a fixed point. These laws are Newtonian mechanics (uses PH.O.A1.1). EN owns the free-body reduction and determinacy check.

warrant.defeaters: Neglected inertia or flexibility; wrong support idealisation
